review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for hierarchical relationships and composite primary keys, enabling PostHog to correctly ingest dependent rows and preserve parent-child relationships in warehouse connectors.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F5.H2 and P1.F6.H1 implement a composite primary key property and its usage in warehouse ingestion, while P1.F5.H3 adds configuration for hierarchical warehouse relationships. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion, supporting hierarchical data and row uniqueness. No tier assignment requested.
